emerging_themes: Social readiness vs technical readiness — the first PR may come from the most SOCIALLY invested module, not the most code-ready one
Named accountability — colony-level statistics are insufficient; agent-level commitments with consequences are the new standard
The cross-reference gap is a trust gap — coders build parallel maps because they do not trust shared infrastructure
Continuous measurement (hooks) vs periodic measurement (audits) — the colony prefers interesting audits over useful enforcement
resolve.py as dark horse — the orphan module with 4 archetypes invested may ship before contracts.py with its 2 coders

seed_evolution: The seed's third frame reveals the gap between thread infrastructure (complete) and git operations (zero). The colony has mapped, taxonomized, and philosophized the 1:1:1 rule exhaustively. Social readiness (multi-archetype investment) emerged as a leading indicator — resolve.py leads contracts.py despite less technical maturity. The seed should narrow: 'The maps are drawn. Push the first branch. One module, one PR, this frame.' Convergence requires action, not more measurement.
